feature: Customer Portal v2 -- the SETTINGS page (/portal-v2/settings), recreated from the prototype's own `isSettings` section ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 4345-4576). Four sections -- Ownership routing, Change control policy, People & roles, Departments -- each a real deep link under the same page. This page is NEW: the round-one handoff had no Settings page at all, so the Round Two entries that read as MOVES ('change control policy moved into Settings', 'People & roles moved from Ownership into Settings') are its first appearance rather than a relocation.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/settings/{section}. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/settings/:section' BEFORE '/portal-v2/settings', and both before '/portal-v2/:pillar'.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree.

ROUND TWO, ITEM 3 IS A NO-OP AND SET6/SET7 RECORD WHY -- AND HOW WEAK THEY ARE. The changelog says two placeholder entries were removed from this nav, 'Scans and alerting' and 'Tenant and billing'. Both strings return ZERO hits in BOTH the round-one and the round-two shell, so there is no state of this design in which they were ever present. SET6/SET7 assert that no nav testid exists for either. Stated plainly: an `absent` assertion on a testid that has never existed passes trivially, so these two are a REINTRODUCTION GUARD, not evidence that a removal happened. They earn their place only because the nav is testid-per-section, so a future session adding one of these sections would have to add the matching testid and would turn them red.

THERE IS NO NEGATIVE TEXT ASSERTION IN THIS HARNESS. `textNotContains` does not exist -- UiTestExecutor.cs implements only `state`, `textContains` and `textPrefixOfAny`, and an unrecognised field on an expect step is silently ignored, which would degrade the step to a bare presence check that passes while asserting nothing. That is why SET6/SET7 assert an absent SELECTOR rather than absent TEXT.

AN ARRAY IN `textContains` IS ANY-OF, NOT ALL-OF. UiTestExecutor.cs:570 renders it as 'textContains any of [...]' and :1282 fails with 'text contained none of [...]'. Every all-of assertion in this manifest is therefore its own step; no step lists multiple phrases expecting all of them.

SELECTING A SECTION MUST NOT LEAVE SETTINGS. The prototype's `sn.go` is setState({ setSection }) -- it changes a field, not `active` (shell 19932). SET8-SET11 prove the equivalent here: navigating to a section keeps the page heading and the section nav on screen.

THE SETTINGS NAV KEEPS ITS LEFT BAR. Round Two's '↳' change names 'Change Control, Ownership, SOPs and Microsoft Changes sub-navigation'; this nav is none of those, and the prototype still draws it with border-left:2px solid #0078D4 (19933). No step here asserts a glyph, deliberately.

SET20-SET23 PIN A DERIVED SENTENCE, NOT A STATIC ONE. The master band's note interpolates the live signature count, so changing 'Signatures required' rewrites it. Asserting the sentence before AND after the change is what proves it is derived rather than two hardcoded strings.

NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select> (it takes the value setter from HTMLInputElement.prototype and throws 'Illegal invocation'), and an unknown action silently PASSES. The Departments 'Set by group' form contains one, so that form is opened but not submitted here; the fallback select is covered by settingsModel.test.ts instead.

WHY THE NUMBERS ARE WHAT THEY ARE: the people foot reads '9 people · 7 at Halden, 2 outside' -- 'outside' folds MSP and External together (Shane McCaw and R. Court), which is the prototype's own arithmetic and the reason the copy says 'outside' rather than 'at the MSP'.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
